ConfidenceBand.description: The band, not the number, is what drives behaviour and what a reader sees.
ConfidenceBand.title: ConfidenceBand

changelog.change: Added evidential_density and speculative_density, nullable, at the end of the row. The ledger's header is migrated in the same commit.
changelog.why: Every other column scores our summary against the article. These two score the article, which nothing did: a faithful summary of an unsourced rumour scores high on all of them and is still an unsourced rumour. First columns to land after the ledger had rows in it, hence appended rather than filed by meaning, and null rather than zero on the ten rows that predate them. Recorded only - no band reads them until enough rows exist to say what a normal value is (Rule #10).

changelog.change: Added unsupported_numbers, hedge_dropped, extraction_suspect, verbatim_run and source_seen_word_count.
changelog.why: Faithfulness cannot see a wrong number, a rumour asserted as fact, or a summary of navigation chrome - it scores all three generously. The ledger is still empty, so these cost a changelog entry today and a migration ever after.

The ledger is the only committed record that survives a run, so it is the only place a later run can detect that identical inputs produced different words. No payload predates this - the ledger has never been written.

changelog.change: Initial shape: dual faithfulness scores, the counterweights, and the band.
changelog.why: Contracts before logic - the columns are fixed before the first row lands.

description: The Evaluate stage's output, appended once per item.

compression.description: Summary length over source length. Recorded, never flagged: at a fixed output budget this measures the article's length, not the summary's quality.
compression.title: Compression

coverage.description: Survival of the lead's entities and numbers. The instrument for omission.
coverage.title: Coverage

determinism_violation.description: Identical inputs, different words. Counted and published, never fatal.
determinism_violation.title: Determinism Violation

evidential_density.description: Attribution markers as a share of the ARTICLE's words. How often the story says where it got a claim. Scores the source, not our summary of it. Null on a row scored before metrics-2.
evidential_density.title: Evidential Density

extraction_suspect.description: The text looks like page furniture. A faithful summary of chrome scores high.
extraction_suspect.title: Extraction Suspect

extractiveness.description: Share of the summary's 4-grams found verbatim in the source.
extractiveness.title: Extractiveness

hedge_dropped.description: The source hedged and the summary asserted. A rumour became a fact.
hedge_dropped.title: Hedge Dropped

hhem.description: Faithfulness against the text the model saw.
hhem.title: Hhem

hhem_delta.description: hhem - hhem_full. The cost of truncation, invisible unless both are scored.
hhem_delta.title: Hhem Delta

score_ms.description: How long the faithfulness scorer took on this item. It decides whether the scorer can stay a census or has to become a sample.
score_ms.title: Score Ms

scorer_version.description: Derived, never hand-typed: the scorer, its weights, the tagger and the band thresholds, spelled so a row still explains itself years later.
scorer_version.title: Scorer Version

source_seen_word_count.description: What the model actually got, after truncation.
source_seen_word_count.title: Source Seen Word Count

speculative_density.description: Unresolved-claim markers as a share of the ARTICLE's words. Read against evidential_density: speculation nobody is cited for is the fragile case. Null on a row scored before metrics-2.
speculative_density.title: Speculative Density

unsupported_numbers.description: Numbers asserted by the summary that appear nowhere in the full source.
unsupported_numbers.title: Unsupported Numbers

verbatim_run.description: Longest unbroken copied stretch. This is the one that names copying.
verbatim_run.title: Verbatim Run
